policy: Independent summary; source pages are mutable. No page-body snapshot or immutable page version is included.

sources.summary: Current page describes issue statuses, maps former workflow labels, says those labels will be unsupported after 2026-02-27, and states Validation/Build may overlap and phases may be skipped with judgement.
Application Lifecycle team page continues to present workflow labels and a team-specific Kanban/blocker process, including skipped validation phases.
GitLab internal deployment-path page distinguishes GitLab.com deployment from Self-Managed release/package publication and describes separate environments and verification events.
Coordinator confirmed the repository page displays a project MIT License marker. No substantial handbook text, templates, figures or source code were reused.
sources.observed_license_scope: Project marker verified; full editorial content reuse scope was not independently established and no substantial text is reused.
